# claudegrid

> claudegrid is a Node.js CLI that opens a grid of Claude Code agents in one command, in KDE Konsole, iTerm2, Terminal.app, tmux, kitty or WezTerm on Linux and macOS, with a prompt, model and optional git worktree per pane. It also has a local desktop app (`claudegrid ui`) and presets in `.claudegrid.json`.

Install with `npm install -g @halitsever/claudegrid` (Node.js 20+), or via the `.deb` from GitHub Releases or `install.sh`. It needs Claude Code and one of the supported terminals installed. Run `claudegrid doctor` to check your setup, and `claudegrid --dry-run` to print the commands without running them. The npm package name is scoped (`@halitsever/claudegrid`), and the command is `claudegrid`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/guide/getting-started): install, `claudegrid doctor` and a first grid
- [Usage](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/guide/usage): layouts, per-pane prompts and models, passing flags to every claude
- [Desktop app](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/guide/app): `claudegrid ui`, a local window to set up, preview and launch panes
- [Configuration](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/guide/configuration): `.claudegrid.json` and the user config, with every key
- [Presets](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/guide/presets): named setups started with one word
- [Git worktrees](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/guide/worktrees): one branch and checkout per agent, then review, merge or clean up
- [Terminals](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/guide/terminals): how each terminal builds the grid and how one is picked automatically
- [CLI reference](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/guide/cli): every command and option
- [Troubleshooting](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/guide/troubleshooting): qdbus6, old tmux, claude not found, worktree errors

## Optional

- [Config JSON schema](https://halitsever.github.io/claudegrid/schema.json): schema for `.claudegrid.json`
